runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of the memorandum. It also applies to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after that same 180-day date.

So for new contracts, the trigger is the solicitation date: solicitations issued 180 days or more after issuance are covered. The memo's consolidated table of required actions also lists a 180-day deadline for each agency to achieve full compliance with the guidance of the memorandum.

Note that the memo does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
